# Flugelsoft Labs — MatsyaSample Assam (NESFIC-D-32)

> Scientific Sample Survey for Pond and Tank Aquaculture Production Estimation
> North East Seva First Innovation Challenge (NESFIC 2026) — Problem Statement NESFIC-D-32
> Challenge Owner: Fishery Department, Government of Assam / Directorate of Fisheries
> Lead Entity: Flugelsoft Labs
> Lead Applicant: Kalyanjit Hatibaruah

## Routes
- `/` : Rotating Sample Frame & Survey Ledger (Nagaon, Kamrup, Dima Hasao, Cachar, Barpeta)
- `/sampling-simulator` : Interactive Stratified Sampling & Confidence Interval Simulator
- `/estimates-audit` : District & State Horvitz-Thompson Estimates Audit (CSV Export)
- `/proposal` : Complete 12-Section NESFIC-D-32 Proposal & Official PDF Downloads
- `/tutorial` : Interactive Application Tutorial & Statistical Methodology Guide
